description: CBG Consultants describes importing Revit models into IESVE for Thrayle House in London and Thomas Gainsborough School in Suffolk. The account records problems with linked models, room volumes, balconies, construction phases and room-bounding elements. The team corrected geometry and used ModelIT to complete analytical building models. This provides a documented example of preparing building geometry for performance simulation. The case concerns model preparation and interoperability. It does not report a quantified building-energy improvement or provide the project models. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
